newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares hit new high, aided by foreign mkts.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares hit new high, aided by foreign mkts.

text.p: The Stockholm bourse closed at a new all-time high on Monday, opening stronger at the start with a boost from U.S. and Tokyo gains and climbing throughout the day.
The Stockholm general index rose 1.88 percent to 2,444.64 after shares worth 4.19 billion crowns were traded.
"The bourse feels fantastic right now," one broker said. "There really seems to be a lot of money about."
Gains were strong across the board with the trading sector rising most, closing 4.33 percent higher as fashion retailer Hennes & Mauritz soared.
